column3: ## Successfully upload a file with no references
Setup: You must be logged in using a pure publisher account (no other privileges)
Go to the "Upload Article XML" tab in the "Publisher Area"

Select "Choose file" and select the test resource file "successful.xml", which contains no "references" element

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/3985_references_article_metadata/doajtest/xml_upload_test_package/DOAJ/successful.xml

column4: A flash message appears at the top of the screen indicating a successful upload

column3: wait a short amount of time for the job to process, then reload the page (do not re-submit the form data).

column4: Your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with status "successfully processed"

column3:
Go to the Table of Contents for the journal (e.g. by going to /toc/2222-2222), go to the Articles tab and open the article "Success!"

column4: No "References" section or heading is shown anywhere on the article page
